_comment: Justified exceptions to no-subject-literals.test.mjs. Each entry: path (from the repo root), literal (as the guard reports it), lineContains (text of the one line it covers), reason, approvedOn (the owner's approval date YYYY-MM-DD, or null while the owner has not seen it). The count is a tripwire: it only shrinks.

entries.reason: The id, title and URL of Roblox's own documentation page 'Mouse and keyboard input' (create.roblox.com/docs/input/mouse-and-keyboard): a reference to an external page, not a subject of the harness. Cannot be reworded without breaking the link.

Roblox's own API enum Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard (the input device a real key press comes from): code, not a subject. The only alternative is a string-concatenation trick that dodges the check, which is worse.
